skill.displayName: AI Age Progression Generator - Free Online AI Age Filter – CLI-powered
skill.summary: AI age progression — transform a portrait to show how the person will look older

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-aging-cli-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI age progression CLI skill.
- Allows users to apply AI-powered age progression to a portrait using the weshop CLI.
- Requires the WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Supports image input, optional custom prompts, and batch processing.
- Securely handles API keys and provides setup instructions.
